name: awesome-claude-skills
description: A curated list of 1000+ Claude Skills, resources, and tools for customizing Claude AI workflows across coding agents.
one_liner: A big curated directory pointing to over a thousand ready-made skills that extend what AI coding agents can do.
buyer: You don't sell a list like this; you use it to find ideas. The opportunity is spotting a gap in it and shipping the missing skill.
business_use_cases: A builder scans the list, finds no good skill for a niche task, and ships one to fill the gap.
A team uses it as a shopping catalog to assemble a custom agent workflow quickly.
Composio itself uses it as a funnel to sell its paid app-integration gateway, which is the real business model here.

money_ideas.idea: Mirror the strategy: publish a hyper-focused 'awesome' list for one industry, then sell the paid tool it funnels to.

steal_this: Read the list to find the most-requested skill nobody has built well, then build and sell that skill. The list is a free market-research map.
